question: How does the 70-coin multi-premia blend perform as a realistic paper account (lot rounding, minimum orders, fees, slippage, real funding) from a fixed start date?
registration_note: Registered 2026-10-03 at the user's request (paper trading first; full 70-coin blend). Paper only: no exchange account, no API keys, no orders. Strategy rules are the frozen multi-premia-blend-v1 legs and weights, executed as the aggregated per-coin target (V_ALL of multi-premia-human-v1) once a day at the 08:00 UTC open. Amended 2026-10-03 before the start: this is a simulated replay requested by the user, not the repository's approval-bound paper execution, so paper_trading_authorized stays false.

execution.decision: per-coin target weights decided with data up to 00:00 UTC of day d (multi_premia_human_forward.coin_targets)
execution.fill_price: the open of the 08:00 UTC 8h bar of day d
execution.quantity: round(target_weight x equity / (price x contractSize)) contracts, using MEXC contract specs fetched at run time (snapshot stored in the report); targets below minVol become 0
execution.cost_per_side: max(listed taker fee, 0.0002) + 0.0005 slippage, on traded notional
execution.funding: MEXC realized funding rates for settlements in (d 08:00, d+1 08:00], paid by longs when positive, received by shorts
execution.mark: positions marked at the next day's 08:00 UTC open

outputs: positions held now with contracts and notional
the theoretical V_ALL return series at 20 bps for comparison (tracking difference)
